103e8f43: Who is Blue Lock's main protagonist?
Yoichi Isagi is the protagonist — an ordinary young striker who enters Blue Lock and gradually develops his weapon: spatial awareness, evolving into Meta Vision.
4a96d859: What is the name of the eccentric director of the Blue Lock program?
Jinpachi Ego is the coach hired by the Japan Football Union to run Blue Lock — provocative and visionary, he believes total egoism is the only path to attacking genius.
dab8ddb8: What is the family link between Rin Itoshi and Sae Itoshi?
Rin and Sae are brothers — Sae is the elder, who went pro in Spain. Their broken relationship drives Rin emotionally throughout the series.
f659d1af: What nickname does Shoei Barou give himself?
Shoei Barou calls himself “the King” — a self-centered striker who naturally believes he is superior to everyone. His weapon is raw power and pinpoint finishing.
4aaf785e: What is Seishiro Nagi's natural talent?
Nagi is a ball-control genius: he can trap any ball perfectly. He had only been playing soccer for a few months when he entered Blue Lock.
56d56d67: Who is Seishiro Nagi's friend and partner?
Reo Mikage is the friend who discovered Nagi and convinced him to play. A billionaire heir, he sees Nagi as the perfect weapon to conquer world soccer.
00700afa: What physical problem haunts Hyoma Chigiri?
Chigiri has a knee injury — he fears that running at full speed will make it worse. Yet his weapon is pure speed, and he will have to overcome this fear to flourish.
366e4c09: Who is Reo Mikage in Blue Lock?
A boy from a modest family dreaming of going pro
A billionaire heir playing to shine with Nagi
A goalkeeper disguised as a striker
Reo Mikage comes from an incredibly wealthy industrial family — he plays soccer to build a perfect team around Seishiro Nagi, his weapon.
0debef9d: In which country does Sae Itoshi play professionally?
Sae Itoshi is a professional playing in Spain — described as one of the best midfielders in the world. His coldness toward his brother Rin is Rin's central trauma.
2f151c5d: What is Anri Teieri's role in Blue Lock?
The only female player in the program
The Japan Football Union's executive director
Anri Teieri is the program's coordinator — she assists Jinpachi Ego and serves as the link with the players. She is one of the few women in the Blue Lock world.
bd4ce323: How does Meguru Bachira describe his playing style?
“I play with the monster inside me”
Bachira talks about an inner “monster” guiding his instinctive, unpredictable dribbling. His soccer is emotional, chaotic and fundamentally egoistic.
04eaa5f3: Why did Sae Itoshi break Rin emotionally in the past?
He abandoned their shared dream and told Rin he was no longer of any use to him
He left the country without saying goodbye
Back from Spain, Sae tells Rin he is giving up their dream of becoming the world's best strikers together, and harshly rejects him. Ever since, Rin has wanted to prove he can surpass him.
091cdc93: What is Seishiro Nagi's distinctive look?
White/silver hair and a relaxed posture
The tallest player in the program
Nagi is recognizable by his white/silver hair and his permanently laid-back posture — his look perfectly embodies the character: a lazy genius who would rather sleep than train.
256add0f: What kind of striker is Rensuke Kunigami at first?
A powerful striker focused on the collective good
Kunigami is a power striker with a strong team spirit — his altruistic motives (playing for others) clash directly with the egoistic philosophy imposed by Blue Lock.
e93598d7: Who is Isagi's main rival in the early stages of Blue Lock?
Rin Itoshi quickly establishes himself as the most complete player — perfect technique, power, vision. He becomes the first true yardstick of Isagi's progress, and their rivalry is central.
634f79be: What is the name of the fictional German club where Michael Kaiser plays?
Bastard München is Blue Lock's fictional German pro club — its provocative name reflects the series' philosophy, and Michael Kaiser is its absolute star.
7cd51520: Which coach, presented as the best striker in the world, does Isagi want to learn from in the Neo Egoist League?
Isagi chooses Bastard München to learn from Noel Noa, the striker considered the best in the world.
2e3e9e2c: What is the main goal of the Blue Lock project?
Create the world's best striker to win the World Cup
Blue Lock aims to create THE world's best striker — Jinpachi Ego is convinced that only an attacker of absolute genius can let Japan win the World Cup.
781fca28: How many players are selected to enter Blue Lock?
300 young Japanese U-18 strikers enter the facility — but only the one who becomes the best keeps a place in the national team. The others risk being banned for life.
3ca51e73: What is Yoichi Isagi's ranking number when he arrives at Blue Lock?
Isagi is ranked 299th out of 300. This detail underlines his “ordinary” status at the start and makes his rise to the top all the more spectacular.
bccff25c: The ability to mentally model the whole field in real time
Meta Vision is the evolution of Isagi's spatial awareness — he perceives every player's trajectory, position and intention at once, so he can always make the best choice.
ddad4206: What does a “weapon” mean in Blue Lock?
A dangerous physical style of play
The unique skill that defines an elite striker
A “weapon” is the unique skill that makes a striker irreplaceable — what sets him apart from everyone else. Jinpachi Ego pushes each player to identify and develop his own.
820e15b6: Which philosophy does Jinpachi Ego impose?
Total egoism as the condition for attacking genius
Ego believes that egoism — scoring for yourself — is the only way. This philosophy directly opposes traditional Japanese “collective” soccer, which he blames for Japan's failures.
e78d74e7: What do players who lose at Blue Lock risk?
A lifetime ban from the Japanese national team
Being sent back to their club
Losers risk a lifetime ban from the national team — the stake that makes every match vital and forces each player to push himself to the limit.
10a727cb: Which magazine publishes the Blue Lock manga?
Blue Lock has been published in Kodansha's Weekly Shōnen Magazine since 2018 — it quickly became one of the most popular sports manga, selling millions of copies.
92423d3f: Which animation studio produced Blue Lock's first anime season?
8bit is the studio behind the Blue Lock anime (2022-2023). Less famous than MAPPA, it delivered a solid production that did justice to the manga's intensity.
1d6541a4: Who writes the Blue Lock manga?
Muneyuki Kaneshiro has written Blue Lock since 2018 — he created the concept and the world. Yusuke Nomura is the artist. The two make a very effective duo.
15fd0f2c: Who draws the Blue Lock manga?
Yusuke Nomura draws Blue Lock — his dynamic, expressive art adds enormously to the series' intensity. The story is by Muneyuki Kaneshiro.
d7763fee: What is Blue Lock's international stage called?
The Neo Egoist League is the stage in which Blue Lock players join fictional pro clubs from around the world to compete — a crucial step toward the World Cup goal.
6bb83f2a: What does the name “Blue Lock” mean literally?
“Blue Lock” evokes a blue padlock — a metaphor for the program that “locks up” Japan's best strikers in an isolated facility to push them to their absolute maximum.
0571346c: Which anime film centered on Seishiro Nagi came out in 2024?
Blue Lock: Episode Nagi came out in 2024 — it tells the story of Nagi and Reo from their first meeting to Blue Lock, from Nagi's point of view. A much-loved companion piece.
876c1182: What is Michael Kaiser's signature technique called?
The Kaiser Impact is Kaiser's shot — of absolute precision and power, able to score from any angle. It embodies the “absolute egoism” of a world-class striker.
d6705838: Which fictional club does Yoichi Isagi join in the Neo Egoist League?
Isagi joins Bastard München, the German club coached by Noel Noa, where Michael Kaiser plays. Their rivalry takes on its full scale there.
52b16878: What is Chigiri's weapon once he is freed from his fear?
Pure speed — the fastest legs in Blue Lock
Chigiri's weapon is his absolute speed — when he overcomes his fear and lets go, he can outrun any defender. It is one of the most cathartic moments of the series.
e2d788d9: Against which team do Blue Lock's best players play a decisive match for the program's future?
Blue Lock's players face Japan's U-20 national team. A defeat would mean the end of the program.
7f8de4cb: What was Isagi's standing at his high school before Blue Lock?
The top scorer in his region
An average high school striker with no notable results
Isagi is an ordinary high school striker — with no particular results. That is exactly why his call-up to Blue Lock is surprising, and why his progress is so spectacular.
f6bab0f7: What great frustration drives Isagi to join Blue Lock?
Never being able to play with friends
Missing a decisive goal that knocked his high school team out
Being rejected by a pro academy
Not being as fast as his teammates

In the decisive moment of a match that knocked his high school team out, Isagi passed to a teammate instead of shooting, and the teammate missed. This scene haunts his early days at Blue Lock and defines his quest for egoism.
e47a99e3: Which fictional club does Rin Itoshi join in the Neo Egoist League?
Rin Itoshi joins PXG (Paris X Gen) in the Neo Egoist League — an elite fictional French club where he keeps progressing as one of the best talents of his generation.
a6e6470f: Which team is Isagi placed in at the start of the Blue Lock program?
Isagi starts in Team Z, the lowest-ranked team, with Bachira, Chigiri, Kunigami and Raichi.
021517c1: Which unpredictable dribbler becomes Isagi's first friend at Blue Lock?
From the very first days, Bachira befriends Isagi, whom he believes can understand his “monster”.
4270cae9: Which team do Nagi and Reo play for in the first selection?
Nagi and Reo play for Team V. Their defeat against Team Z marks a turning point for Nagi.
fa7a319b: By what score does Blue Lock beat Japan's U-20 national team?
At the end of a crazy match, Blue Lock wins 4-3. The last goal is scored by Isagi.
7237dc6e: Who scores Blue Lock's winning goal against the U-20 team?
In the final seconds, Isagi scores with a volley and gives Blue Lock the win.
9fd1e6c9: Which unpredictable striker nicknamed “the Devil” plays for the U-20 team against Blue Lock?
Ryusei Shidou, formerly number 1 in Blue Lock's rankings, joins the U-20 team alongside Sae Itoshi.
739997f1: Which club represents Italy in the Neo Egoist League?
The five clubs of the Neo Egoist League are Bastard München (Germany), Manshine City (England), FC Barcha (Spain), Ubers (Italy) and PXG (France).
32f1f194: Which country is the club Manshine City from in the Neo Egoist League?
Manshine City is the English club of the Neo Egoist League. Nagi and Chigiri play there.
2fb2e241: How are players ranked during the Neo Egoist League?
By a market value in yen
Each player gets a market value, set by the clubs' bids, which changes based on his performances.
9bb06ee1: What is the state of absolute concentration some players reach called?
“Flow” is a state of extreme concentration in which a player expresses his talent to the fullest.
f71b916c: Which of Kaiser's Bastard München teammates is his loyal provider?
Alexis Ness is the playmaker devoted to Michael Kaiser, until the rivalry with Isagi shakes everything up.
2f77cf51: Which Japanese national team failure led to the creation of Blue Lock, according to the story?
After Japan's elimination at the 2018 World Cup, the federation launches the Blue Lock project to produce a world-class striker.
716c9945: In what year did the Blue Lock anime start?
Season 1, animated by 8bit, started in October 2022. Season 2 followed in October 2024.
d8b41fad: Which player returns to the program through a secret back door called the “Wild Card”?
Eliminated, Kunigami rejoins the project through the secret Wild Card program and comes back deeply changed.
